abort.already_in_progress: This is already being configured. Finish the existing configuration before starting again.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. The charger accepts one Bluetooth client at a time, so close the phone app and try again. See [Setup can't find or reach the charger](https://github.com/Dr-Blank/spinev-ha/blob/main/docs/connection.md).
abort.no_devices_found: No Spin EV charger was found over Bluetooth. Check that the charger is powered on, that no phone app is connected to it (it accepts one Bluetooth client at a time), and that Home Assistant has a Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy in range of the charger. See [Setup can't find or reach the charger](https://github.com/Dr-Blank/spinev-ha/blob/main/docs/connection.md) for the full checklist.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Spin EV charger.

data_description.charging_interval: How often to read the charger while a vehicle is charging.
data_description.connection_mode: Reconnect each poll keeps the phone app usable between polls, at the cost of about a second of extra latency per poll and more reconnect churn. Stay connected polls faster and fails less often, but locks the phone app out for as long as the integration is enabled.
data_description.idle_interval: How often to read the charger while no vehicle is charging. Keep this long, especially with reconnect each poll, so the phone app gets long uncontested stretches.

init.description: The charger accepts one Bluetooth client at a time, so Home Assistant and the phone app cannot both be connected.
